CustomObject.description: Org-specific secrets/config for the Meta Lead Ads integration (verify token, app secret, Conversions API dataset config). A Custom Setting so it is always readable by Apex — including the Guest User running the inbound webhook — regardless of sharing/FLS, which a regular Custom Object cannot provide. Each connected org keeps its own values (Custom Setting data, not deployed metadata), so deploying this package's Apex/LWC changes to one org never touches another org's values. Ships with no default row; created the first time an admin saves the Integration Settings tab on the Meta Lead Capture Setup page.
CustomObject.label: Meta Integration Config
